minor.comment: Initial release: a Result boundary over the `ollama` JS library for the native Ollama API that its OpenAI-compatible endpoint cannot express. Node only; completion and tool use stay in `@fgv/ts-extras` ai-assist.
Model management: `listModels`, `listRunning`, `showModel`, `deleteModel`, and `pullModel` with streamed progress.
`chatStructured`: grammar-constrained structured output validated against a JSON schema.
